article.body:
Both The Ultimate Snooze adjustable bases elevate your sleep beyond what a flat mattress can do. The question is how much customization and control you want.

Here is a straightforward breakdown of both models, what they do, and which one makes sense for your sleep setup.

What an Adjustable Base Actually Does

An adjustable base lets you change the angle of your head and your feet independently — and in many cases, simultaneously. This is not just about watching TV in bed.

Elevating the head helps open the airway, which can reduce snoring and improve breathing during sleep. Elevating the feet reduces pressure on the lower back and improves circulation. The zero-gravity position — head and feet both slightly elevated — is based on the posture NASA designed for astronauts during launch, distributing body weight evenly to reduce spinal pressure.

For people with acid reflux, sleep apnea, back pain, swollen legs, or circulation issues, these are functional benefits, not just comfort features.

Combined with an organic latex mattress, the adjustable base becomes a full sleep optimization system. Latex responds immediately to pressure without the slow sinking of foam — so every position adjustment is accurate and comfortable.

The 3.0 Adjustable Base (Core™ Bundle)

The 3.0 Adjustable Base is included in the Core™ Bundle alongside the Pure Organic Latex Mattress (Medium Firm).

It provides essential adjustable base functionality — head and foot incline control, wireless remote operation, and compatibility with the Split King configuration so each person on a Split King controls their own side independently.

The 3.0 is the right choice if you want the functional benefits of an adjustable sleep system — better breathing, reduced back pressure, improved circulation — without paying for additional features you may not use.

For people new to adjustable bases, the 3.0 is often the ideal starting point. The core functionality delivers the majority of the health and comfort benefits.

The 5.0 Adjustable Base (Elite™ Bundle)

The 5.0 Adjustable Base is included in the Elite™ Bundle alongside the Recovery Organic Latex Mattress (Medium feel, 13 inches, 4-inch organic Talalay latex layer).

The 5.0 adds advanced comfort settings and greater customization beyond the 3.0's foundation. It is designed for people who want the full premium adjustable base experience — more control, more positions, more recovery-focused features.

The Elite Bundle as a whole is designed for those who want every component optimized: the more advanced base paired with the thicker, more pressure-contouring Recovery mattress.

Split King Compatibility

Both the 3.0 and 5.0 adjustable bases are available in Split King configuration.

A Split King uses two Twin XL mattresses on two independent bases — each person fully controls their own head and foot position without affecting the other side. This eliminates the most common couple's sleep conflict: one person wants to elevate, the other does not.

It also eliminates motion transfer. If one partner gets up during the night, the other does not feel it.

Which One Is Right for You?

Choose the 3.0 (Core™ Bundle) if you want all the functional benefits of an adjustable sleep system at a better value, and you prefer a Medium Firm feel that provides a firmer foundation under your body.

Choose the 5.0 (Elite™ Bundle) if you want the most advanced adjustable base available, prefer the Medium feel of the Recovery mattress with its thicker latex comfort layer, and want maximum customization in your sleep environment.

Both are built for the same goal: better sleep through better positioning and better materials.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the difference between the 3.0 and 5.0 adjustable base?
The 3.0 is the foundational model with core adjustable base functionality. The 5.0 is the advanced model with greater customization. The 3.0 is in the Core™ Bundle; the 5.0 is in the Elite™ Bundle.

Do both bases support Split King?
Yes. Both the 3.0 and 5.0 are available in Split King configuration for independent control on each side.

Can I use the adjustable base without the bundle?
The bases are sold as part of the Core™ and Elite™ bundles. Visit theultimatesnooze.com/collections/bundle for current configurations and pricing.

Which mattress works with which base?
The Core™ Bundle pairs the 3.0 base with the Pure Organic Latex Mattress (Medium Firm). The Elite™ Bundle pairs the 5.0 base with the Recovery Organic Latex Mattress (Medium feel).

Is an adjustable base worth it?
For people with back pain, snoring, acid reflux, poor circulation, or anyone who sleeps with a partner who has different sleep preferences — yes. See our full breakdown: Are Adjustable Bases Worth It?

Final Thought

Both bases deliver the core benefit of adjustable sleep: better positioning, better breathing, less pressure on the spine. The choice between 3.0 and 5.0 comes down to how much customization you want and which mattress feel — Medium Firm or Medium — is right for your body.
